provider_verified.description: True when the provider verified against every consumer pact; null ONLY for ERROR (verification did not run).

verified.description: null = not run (ERROR), distinct from a real negative result.

pact_ref.description: Runner mode: reference to the verified pact document.

result_ref.description: Runner mode: run-relative, offline reference to the verification result.

content_hash.description: Runner mode: content hash of the verification evidence.

can_i_deploy.description: Pact Broker can-i-deploy COMPATIBILITY result — evidence for the release decision, not release authorization. Null ONLY for ERROR.

errors.description: Non-empty when verdict is ERROR: why verification or the broker query could not run.

execution.description: Honest execution provenance: replay = corpus evidence replayed (proves the contract, not a runner-backed verification); runner = live CI/test-runner + broker execution.

audit_id.description: Producer-stamped deterministic provenance id: UUIDv5(HOUSE_NS, "contract-tests:{idempotency_key}") with HOUSE_NS = uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, "https://squad-delivery/audit"). Distinct from the engine's per-attempt execution audit id.

allOf.description: PASS must be backed by full verification: provider verified, broker gate true, every pact verified.
FAIL must contain at least one unverified pact or a false broker gate.
Only ERROR may carry null results, and it must say why.
Non-ERROR verdicts carry real boolean results.
Runner mode must carry its provenance.
